name: "Start runner diagnostics"
description: >
  Spawn `monitor.ps1` as a hidden background process for the current job.
  The monitor writes `spec-snapshot.json` at startup and then samples
  host + GPU metrics into JSONL files in the output directory. Pair with
  `stop-runner-diagnostics` in an `if: always()` step at end of job.

inputs:
  output-dir:
    description: "Diagnostics directory. Default: $RUNNER_TEMP\\runner-diagnostics."
    required: false
    default: ""
  interval-seconds:
    description: "Sampling interval in seconds."
    required: false
    default: "10"

outputs:
  output-dir:
    description: "Resolved diagnostics directory; pass to `stop-runner-diagnostics`."
    value: ${{ steps.spawn.outputs.output-dir }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Spawn background monitor
      id: spawn
      shell: powershell
      env:
        INPUT_OUTPUT_DIR: ${{ inputs.output-dir }}
        INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.interval-seconds }}
      run: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

        $outDir = if ($env:INPUT_OUTPUT_DIR) { $env:INPUT_OUTPUT_DIR } else { Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "runner-diagnostics" }
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
        Remove-Item (Join-Path $outDir ".stop") -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        Remove-Item (Join-Path $outDir ".pid")  -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        # Action lives at <repo>/.github/actions/start-runner-diagnostics/,
        # script lives at <repo>/scripts/runner-diagnostics/monitor.ps1.
        $repoRoot = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:GITHUB_ACTION_PATH "..\..\..")).Path
        $script   = Join-Path $repoRoot "scripts\runner-diagnostics\monitor.ps1"
        $proc = Start-Process powershell `
          -ArgumentList "-NoLogo","-NoProfile","-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass","-File",$script,"-OutputDir",$outDir,"-IntervalSeconds",$env:INTERVAL `
          -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
        $proc.Id | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $outDir ".pid") -Encoding utf8
        Write-Host "Diagnostics monitor PID=$($proc.Id) interval=${env:INTERVAL}s output=$outDir"

        "output-dir=$outDir" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding utf8

name: "Download artifact from internal storage"
description: >
  Fetch a zip from the on-prem artifact server and unzip it. Used as
  the primary artifact transport in `_rtx-test.yml`, with
  `actions/download-artifact` kept as an automatic fallback. Pair with
  `upload-local-artifact` on the producer side.

inputs:
  artifact-name:
    description: "Base filename of the zip on the server (`.zip` is appended)."
    required: true
  dest-dir:
    description: >
      Directory to unzip into. Defaults to `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE` so the
      round-trip with `upload-local-artifact` lands files at the same
      workspace-relative paths the upload step zipped from.
    required: false
    default: ""
  server-url:
    description: >
      Base URL of the artifact server (no trailing slash). No default is
      shipped; pass it explicitly, e.g. from a repository variable such as
      `${{ vars.ARTIFACT_SERVER_URL }}`.
    required: true
  fetch-test-times:
    description: >
      If 'true', also fetch `test-times.zip` and stage it under
      `<dest-dir>/<run_id>/<build-environment>/build-results/.additional_ci_files/`
      (mirrors upstream's sharding-hints layout). Requires `build-environment`
      to be set.
    required: false
    default: "false"
  build-environment:
    description: "Required only when fetch-test-times is 'true'."
    required: false
    default: ""

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Fetch and unzip from internal storage
      shell: bash
      env:
        ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
        DEST_DIR: ${{ inputs.dest-dir }}
        SERVER_URL: ${{ inputs.server-url }}
        FETCH_TEST_TIMES: ${{ inputs.fetch-test-times }}
        BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
      run: |
        : "${DEST_DIR:=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
        export DEST_DIR
        # Action lives at <repo>/.github/actions/download-local-artifact/,
        # script lives at <repo>/scripts/local-artifact/.
        script_dir="$(cd -- "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../../../scripts/local-artifact" && pwd -P)"
        bash "$script_dir/download.sh"

name: "Upload artifact to internal storage"
description: >
  Zip the given directory and POST it to the on-prem artifact server
  that backs the self-hosted Windows pool. Used as the primary
  artifact transport in `_rtx-build.yml`, with `actions/upload-artifact`
  kept as an automatic fallback. Pair with `download-local-artifact`
  on the consumer side.

inputs:
  artifact-name:
    description: "Base filename for the zip (`.zip` is appended on upload)."
    required: true
  source-dir:
    description: >
      Directory to zip and POST. Its basename becomes the zip root, so
      `source-dir: artifact` produces a zip whose entries are `artifact/...`
      and unzipping at the workspace root restores the original layout.
    required: true
  server-url:
    description: >
      Base URL of the artifact server (no trailing slash). No default is
      shipped; pass it explicitly, e.g. from a repository variable such as
      `${{ vars.ARTIFACT_SERVER_URL }}`.
    required: true

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Zip and POST to internal storage
      shell: bash
      env:
        ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ inputs.artifact-name }}
        SOURCE_DIR: ${{ inputs.source-dir }}
        SERVER_URL: ${{ inputs.server-url }}
      run: |
        # Action lives at <repo>/.github/actions/upload-local-artifact/,
        # script lives at <repo>/scripts/local-artifact/.
        script_dir="$(cd -- "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../../../scripts/local-artifact" && pwd -P)"
        bash "$script_dir/upload.sh"
